ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Used to create #anchor-links on the page (numbers, letters, hyphens only).

Image.helper: Use a 2400 × 1200 px (2:1) image, preferably WebP (JPG fallback), optimized to ≤ 350 KB (WebP) or ≤ 500 KB (JPG), with important content centered so it crops cleanly on all screen sizes.

ImageAlt.helper: Describe the image for screenreader & other nonvisual web browsers.

PageTitle.helper: Enter the page title to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

TitleCssClass.helper: Enter the title style name to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

TitleIcon.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

Subtitle.helper: Enter the subtitle to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

SubtitleCssClass.helper: Enter the subtitle style name to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

SubtitleIcon.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

PaText.helper: If any text is entered, the primary action button will attempt to render.

PaUrl.helper: Enter the web address for pa web addresses. You can use a page on this site or another website.

PaCssClass.helper: Applied to the primary action link.

PaLabel.helper: Describe the button's action for screenreaders & other nonvisual web browsers.

PaIcon.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

SaText.helper: If any text is entered, the primary action button will attempt to render.

SaUrl.helper: Enter the web address for sa web addresses. You can use a page on this site or another website.

SaCssClass.helper: Applied to the secondary action link.

SaLabel.helper: Describe the button's action for screenreaders & other nonvisual web browsers.

SaIcon.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.
